patch_description:
This crossover version keeps the strongest parts of the prior feature sets while shifting the model toward shorter lookbacks, regime-invariant rolling normalization, and explicit market-character change features. It removes some slower, regime-specific structures, adds compact z-scored momentum/volatility/efficiency signals, and preserves the key interaction term momentum × volatility regime.  
On the model side, it slightly increases tree depth and reduces over-regularization collapse by using a more balanced XGBoost configuration with stronger sample constraints than the most aggressive runs, aiming to improve validation slope and prediction dispersion without sacrificing directional accuracy.
